create_file_upload: create a file upload for a project using the FileUploadAPI endpoint with a project ID
bulk_create_tasks: bulk create tasks for a project using the TasksBulkCreateAPI endpoint with a project ID
import_project_data: import data into a project using the ImportAPI endpoint with a project ID
import_predictions: import predictions into a project using the ImportPredictionsAPI endpoint with a project ID
reimport_project_data: reimport data into a project using the ReImportAPI endpoint with a project ID
list_file_uploads: list file uploads for a project using the FileUploadListAPI endpoint with a project ID
serve_uploaded_file: serve an uploaded file using the UploadedFileResponse endpoint with a filename path
download_storage_data: download storage data using the DownloadStorageData endpoint from storage-data/uploaded/
